Xanthe: Xanthe is very similar to her sister below (Xanthie). The only differenceis that Xanthe can see what is going to happen even before they get to the stadium and she will therefore act accordingly. (She'll make sure her camcorder is charged.)
Xanthie: If (begrudgingly) at a football game with a group of people that included Kendra, and the conversation turned to the possibility of what it'd be like to do a naked sprint across the ground while play was taking place, Xanthie would immediately shake her head, wish everyone a quick farewell and (gratefully) leave before the carnage began. She's not that silly to want to stick around.
Xenia: Like a very expensive vase made of imported crystal, Xenia likes to know what's going on, she likes to contain chaos and, if she's in charge of a situation, and she usually is, then I wouldn't go changing the designated plan unless you get the okay from her, first. Having said all that, like an unexpected volano erupting in the middle of a calm sea, she will surprise you from time to time in quite remarkable ways. In this situation - say, she decided to jump into a pool from a formal first floor cocktail party - our advice is to do what she does.
Xiindi: Highly energetic like a sexy little buzz-beetle, Xiindi is musical and worldly, as well as perfectly peculiar.
Xitise: Xitise (pronounced Zateece) hides away from finding out what she really wants from life by camouflaging herself into a neat, functioning city life by living in a nice place, working in a decent 9 to 5 job, having nice clothes, having good friends who she goes out with often, and by giving herself semi-unwittingly to the brain washing that society seems to place on humans who congregate together like rats. Don't get us wrong, Xitise is lovely, but she can do better!
